The separate mutation oracle verifies original operation before/after records, retained objects, distinct replacement identities and actual descriptor/name witnesses; the original report is never modified.
doctrines: Successful staged-index and commit-hook gates are required conditions of the durable work-unit commit; full CI/push and historical startup/native/parent gates remain open.

No qualification source repair or fixture rerun occurred. Exact prior acceptance history, task/book/Knowledge Map and work-unit Git history retain continuity.
falsification: Thirty-two altered reports, five altered domains and three source assumptions reject. They challenge selection, preparation, completed mutation, live witness identity, unchanged bytes versus changed names, preserved originals, cleanup, other owners, absent allocations and no-process behavior. Source proofs bind immediate source ownership and native/named/directory rechecks.

limits: Finite synchronous replacement after source admission only. This does not qualify asynchronous races, lower-reader failed-handoff custody, native execution or exact observation release. Bytes remain identical, so the independent oracle must distinguish original and replacement native identities rather than accepting content equality alone.
